title: H3175 (123rd General Assembly): Concealed weapon onto residence

provenance.fetched_by: LegiScan bulk data (gun-policy Stage 5, South Carolina); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official South Carolina text (Introduced, 2018-12-18; official copy, https://www.scstatehouse.gov/sess123_2019-2020/prever/3175_20181218.htm (LegiScan doc 1831150))
provenance.note: Introduced text, Dec. 18, 2018. No votes. The existing rule and penalty (permit holders may not carry into another's residence without permission; misdemeanor, permit revoked five years) are unchanged.

operative_text: Section 1 (Section 23-31-225): This section shall not apply to a real estate broker, real estate sales person, or real estate property manager as defined in Section 40-57-30 when visiting a residence or dwelling, whether occupied or vacant, for the purpose of inspection, appraisal, sale, or lease of a residence or dwelling place.
